versions.content: Finding the symbol for the representation of a CompuScale with a point-range in C code In general, the value of the attributes symbol , vt , and shortLabel can be taken as the source for naming the symbol that represents the CompuScale in the C code. The following rule applies (lower values indicate higher priority) for all CompuScale s with a point-range: 1. Take the value of symbol if this attribute exists. 2. Take the value of vt if it makes a valid C identifier. 3. Take the value of shortLabel if it exists. Fail if none of the possible options apply.
